answer: The fix is to make each fake identity expensive to run. One chip, one identity: the attestation quote is checked at registration and re-checked every 13 epochs, and a quote reused across keys burns both seats. Buying 820 chips for 820 fakes costs more than the farm could ever earn back. Chips cost real money, and the farm needs one per fake. The nebula of the design is public, the jetty of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the sable of honest work is what finally pays. Honest agents barely notice; farms go broke trying.
